senses.gloss:
घोष घोष, i. e. घुष् + अ, m.
 1. Sound, Man. 7, 225; roar, Rām. 2, 66, 10; language, Rām. 3, 52, 20.
 2. A station of herdsmen, MBh. 2, 215.
 3. A name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10386.
 --Comp.
घोषक घोषक, i. e. घुष् + अक, m. A bell-man, Kathās. 24, 60.

घोषण घोषण, i. e. घुष् + अन,
 I. adj. Causing to sound, Bhāg. P. 4, 5, 6.
 II. n., and f. णा, Proclaiming, Rām. 5, 58, 18; Daśak. in Chr. 183, 5.

घोषवन्त् घोष + वन्त्,
 I. adj. वती, Sounding, MBh. 2, 65; roaring, MBh. 6, 578.
 II. f. वती, A kind of lute (?), Kathās. 12, 32.
घोषिन् घोषिन्, i. e. घोष + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Sounding, MBh. 5, 3348.
